playstyle.identity: Sion is an infinite-scaling HP tank who charges across the map with his ultimate. His passive lets him fight on after death, making him annoying to deal with.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: on death, reanimate and attack until dying again. Q charges a knockup. W shields and explodes. E pushes minions/champions and shreds armor. R charges across map, stunning on impact. Stack health with W passive. R for engage or roams.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Sion spikes with health stacks and at 6 with R engage. Sunfire and health items scale his passive. He's a late-game health monster.

passive.name: Glory in Death
passive.summary: On death, reanimate as a zombie that attacks until dying again.
passive.details: When Sion dies, he reanimates for a few seconds, gaining bonus lifesteal and attack speed but rapidly decaying health. He can move and attack freely.

abilities.name: Decimating Smash
abilities.summary: Charge and release a knockup; longer charge = more damage and range.
abilities.details: Sion charges up a heavy blow. Release to damage and knock up enemies. Longer charge increases range, damage, and knockup duration.

abilities.name: Soul Furnace
abilities.summary: Passive: gain permanent health from kills. Active: shield that explodes.
abilities.details: Passive: Sion gains permanent bonus health for killing units. Active: Sion shields himself. After a delay or on recast, the shield explodes for damage.

abilities.name: Roar of the Slayer
abilities.summary: Shout to damage, slow, and reduce armor; pushes minions.
abilities.details: Sion roars in a direction, damaging the first enemy hit, slowing them, and reducing their armor. If it hits a minion, the minion is pushed and damages enemies behind.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
abilities.summary: Charge in a direction; impact stuns and deals damage.
abilities.details: Sion charges in a direction, becoming unstoppable and accelerating. Impact deals damage and stuns enemies, with damage and stun duration increasing with distance.
